card.name: Each or every starting a per-unit statement
card.fires_on: The word every or Each that begins a per-unit statement, such as every minute or Each vial contains. It also fires on a digit or space right before a per-unit amount.

modes.label: Every in rate statements
modes.description: The word every introduces a frequency in a statistic, such as every minute or every year.
modes.example: Did you know that<< every>> minute one woman dies from often-prevent

modes.label: Each starting a content sentence
modes.description: A sentence-initial Each introduces what one dose, capsule or vial contains.

modes.label: Digit starting a per-kg dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose amount before a per-unit expression like mg/kg.

card.writes: It suppresses each and every in several languages, so the next word is less likely to repeat that idea.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text says 'every' or 'each' to describe an amount per unit, like per vial or per minute.
